feed.title: KTUP ETF Analysis: Dividends, Returns BOATS:KTUP
feed.summary: This article provides an analysis of the T-REX 2X Long KTOS Daily Target ETF (KTUP), detailing its structure, investment strategy, and key financial metrics. KTUP uses swap agreements to make bullish bets on Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. and is designed for short-term tactical use due to its leveraged nature. The ETF has an expense ratio of 1.50% and pays annual dividends, with a current indicated yield of 5.84%.

feed.title: IRT’s purchase of Centerspace driven by scale, diversification
feed.summary: Independence Realty Trust (IRT) has acquired Centerspace, creating an $8.1 billion REIT. The acquisition aims to enhance IRT's scale and diversification, integrating Centerspace's Midwest and Mountain West properties to complement IRT's Sun Belt focus. This move is expected to generate significant annualized synergies, primarily from corporate and administrative efficiencies, and improve access to capital markets.

feed.title: Canterbury Park Holding Corporation Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
feed.summary: Canterbury Park Holding Corporation announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share, payable on October 14, 2026, to stockholders of record on September 30, 2026. This translates to an annual dividend of $0.28 per common share. The company owns and operates Canterbury Park Racetrack and Casino in Shakopee, Minnesota, and is also engaged in developing its underutilized land for mixed-use opportunities.

feed.title: Patrick Dempsey Is the New Face of Guardant Health’s ‘The Reckoning’ Campaign
feed.summary: Patrick Dempsey is spearheading Guardant Health's new multi-million dollar "The Reckoning" campaign, urging early colorectal cancer screening with Guardant's Shield™ blood test. The campaign highlights the rising death toll from colorectal cancer, particularly among younger adults, and promotes Shield™ as the first FDA-approved primary blood test for screening. Dempsey, a long-time cancer advocate, aims to reduce screening barriers and honor those affected by the disease.

feed.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill (NYSE:CMG) Stock Price Down 6.7% - Time to Sell?
feed.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG) stock dropped 6.7% to $34.56, with trading volume 41% below average, as it tests support levels amid consumer-discretionary weakness and profit-taking. Despite the dip, the company is pursuing aggressive long-term growth with plans for up to 370 new restaurants in 2026 and an expanded Apprentice program. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $43.84, even as valuation remains elevated and international expansion carries execution and valuation risks.

feed.title: Broadridge expands to offer crypto and tokenized investments
feed.summary: Broadridge (BR) has announced an expansion into crypto and tokenized investments, allowing its clients to view these assets alongside their traditional stocks and bonds within the same portfolio. This move aims to integrate digital assets more seamlessly into existing investment management platforms. Scott Melker discussed this development on "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker."

feed.title: Norwegian Cruise Line contacted individuals on the Do Not Call Registry, a new class action lawsuit alleges
feed.summary: A new class action lawsuit has been filed against Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. by Irene Sorriento, alleging the company made unsolicited telemarketing calls to her cellphone, which has been on the National Do Not Call Registry since 2004. The complaint, filed on September 10, 2026, claims Sorriento received two vacation sales calls in April 2026, violating the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA). The lawsuit seeks to represent a class of individuals who received multiple calls from Norwegian Cruise Line while their numbers were on the Do Not Call Registry, asking for damages and an injunction to stop future calls.

feed.title: Jim Cramer Says “Target’s Doing Better than Walmart Right Now”
feed.summary: Jim Cramer commented on Walmart and Target, suggesting that Target is currently performing better than Walmart. He advised a nuanced buying strategy for Walmart due to its valuation, while acknowledging Target's stronger comparable sales momentum. Despite Cramer's view, hedge fund data indicates more funds hold Walmart than Target.

feed.title: What’s Behind Monte Rosa Therapeutics (NASDAQ:GLUE) Latest Slide?
feed.summary: Monte Rosa Therapeutics (NASDAQ:GLUE) has experienced a market slide, putting renewed focus on its clinical-stage biotechnology business. The company specializes in molecular glue technology to selectively remove disease-causing proteins, a distinct approach in drug development. Recent weaker quarterly figures and ongoing clinical development are contributing factors to the pressure on GLUE, highlighting the significant financial resources required for its scientific platform and pipeline advancement.

feed.title: EOG Needs More Scale to Advance Australian Beehive Prospect
feed.summary: EOG Resources is evaluating options for its Beehive prospect offshore Australia. CEO Ezra Yacob stated that the opportunity has decreased in priority due to its limited scale compared to other prospects in the Middle East. The company is seeking more scale to advance the Australian project.

feed.title: Monte Rosa Therapeutics (NASDAQ:GLUE) Stock Price Down 6% - What's Next?
feed.summary: Monte Rosa Therapeutics (NASDAQ:GLUE) experienced a 6% drop in its stock price, trading at $13.07, with a significant decrease in trading volume. This decline follows the company missing its quarterly earnings and revenue expectations. Despite the negative performance and insider stock sales, analysts generally maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $28.50.

feed.title: ResMed (NYSE:RMD) Trading 4.5% Higher - Here's What Happened
feed.summary: ResMed (NYSE:RMD) saw its shares trade up 4.5% on Tuesday, despite lower than average trading volume. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates with an EPS of $2.95 and an 8.6% increase in revenue year-over-year. Additionally, ResMed raised its quarterly dividend from $0.60 to $0.66 per share, and several analysts increased their price targets for the stock, though the consensus rating remains "Hold."

feed.title: Flex finalizes spinoff plans with corporate structure shakeup, new company name
feed.summary: Flex, a major Austin-based manufacturing company, is finalizing plans for the spinoff of its Axiom Solutions division. The separation, which will include a corporate structure shakeup and a new company name, is expected to be official by early next year and will also involve a CEO change. Flex is known for manufacturing products for large companies like Apple, Dell, and Microsoft across various industries globally.

feed.title: U.S. Air Force and Northrop Grumman Assemble Inert Missile, Progress Toward Sentinel Flight Testing
feed.summary: The U.S. Air Force and Northrop Grumman have successfully assembled an inert Sentinel missile in its operational orientation, marking significant progress toward flight testing in 2027. This vertical assembly demonstrates the missile's design integration and validates the processes for safe assembly and eventual deployment. The Sentinel program is a crucial modernization of the nation's strategic nuclear triad, aiming for initial capability in the early 2030s.

feed.title: Walmart Turns Pharmacists Into Health Ambassadors in Rural Pilot
feed.summary: Walmart is launching a six-month pilot program in rural communities across five states, transforming pharmacists into "health ambassadors." These trained pharmacists will offer personalized health coaching on topics like nutrition, sleep, and stress, and connect customers with relevant Walmart health services and community resources. The initiative aims to make health resources more accessible and actionable in medically underserved areas.

feed.title: Huntington Bank promotes executive likely to become its next CEO
feed.summary: Huntington Bank has named Brant Standridge as its new president, positioning him as the likely successor to current CEO Steven Steinour, who will remain in his role for several more years. This move is part of a long-term succession plan following a period of significant growth for the bank, including recent acquisitions and new sports partnerships. Standridge's promotion reflects his deep banking experience and role in advancing the bank's growth agenda since joining in 2022.

Oldham will be responsible for operations across 29 locations in five states. He previously served as CEO of another John Deere dealership.

feed.title: CenterPoint confirms customer information exposed in data breach
feed.summary: CenterPoint Energy has confirmed that customer information was exposed during a recent data breach. The utility company is investigating the incident and taking steps to protect affected individuals. Customers are advised to monitor their accounts for suspicious activity.

feed.title: Chipotle Bolsters Apprentice Program to Focus on Talent Development
feed.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill is enhancing its Apprentice program to develop talent, strengthen restaurant operations, and support its goal of opening 7,000 restaurants in the U.S. and Canada. The company plans to place an Apprentice in each of its over 4,200 company-owned restaurants by the end of 2027, building on its commitment to promoting from within, as over 85% of its restaurant managers started as Crew Members. Additionally, Chipotle celebrates the 10th anniversary of its Cultivate Education program, which has seen nearly 25,000 employees enroll and has contributed to lower turnover and higher promotion rates among participants.

feed.title: US agency orders Tesla to answer questions on Cybercab certification
feed.summary: The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has ordered Tesla to respond by September 30 regarding questions about the self-certification of its autonomous Cybercab robotaxi. NHTSA's investigation focuses on whether temporarily installed human driver controls or other equipment were part of Tesla's basis for certifying compliance. This order comes as part of a broader government inquiry into the Cybercab's autonomous capabilities.

feed.title: Al Shams nominates five directors for Braemar Hotels board
feed.summary: Al Shams Investments Limited, the largest shareholder of Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (NYSE:BHR), has nominated five candidates for election to Braemar's board of directors at the upcoming annual meeting on November 13, 2026. This move comes in response to a significant decline in Braemar's stock price since 2013 and concerns over substantial fees paid to the company's external advisor amidst underperformance. The nominees include individuals with strong backgrounds in real estate finance, investment, corporate governance, and former royal service.

feed.title: CenterPoint confirms customer data stolen after online leak, faces lawsuits
feed.summary: CenterPoint Energy has confirmed that an unauthorized third party obtained personal information from some of its customers following an online leak. The company stated that electric and gas services were not affected and remain operational. This announcement comes as CenterPoint faces several proposed class-action lawsuits in Texas, Indiana, and Minnesota related to the alleged data breach.

feed.title: iCloud+ gets an upgrade in 100 countries: Free Apple TV, Arcade, and new Music Select
feed.summary: Apple is upgrading iCloud+ subscriptions in over 100 countries, offering free access to Apple TV, Apple Arcade, and curated Apple Music Select stations without additional cost. This new bundle effectively replaces Apple One in these regions, providing existing iCloud+ subscribers with enhanced entertainment options. Notably, major markets like the U.S., U.K., Canada, Australia, and many large European nations are excluded from this offering.

feed.title: We Need C4’s New Hershey And Reese’s Protein Shakes ASAP
feed.summary: C4 has launched new Hershey's Milk Chocolate and Reese's Peanut Butter & Chocolate protein shakes in ready-to-drink format for the UK and European markets. These shakes contain 25 grams of protein and no added sugar, expanding C4's protein offerings beyond powders and sparkling beverages. While the U.S. market has the protein powders, the ready-to-drink shakes have not yet been announced for release there, leaving American fans hoping for future availability.

feed.summary: Morgan Stanley analysts have identified EchoStar (ECHO) as an attractive way for investors to gain exposure to SpaceX (SPCX) at a discounted rate. Analyst Sean Diffley initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a $134 price target, citing EchoStar's undervalued stock, its significant stake in SpaceX from a spectrum license deal, and its scarce spectrum asset. Despite some drawbacks like assets in bankruptcy, Wall Street has a Strong Buy consensus on EchoStar, with an average price target implying a 37% upside.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley co-president Dan Simkowitz: AI slowdown or pause really doesn't change core dynamics
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley co-president Dan Simkowitz believes that any potential slowdown or pause in the artificial intelligence sector will not fundamentally alter its core dynamics. Simkowitz discussed the IPO market, OpenAI, Anthropic, and AI regulation with CNBC's David Faber. This perspective suggests a long-term view on AI's impact despite short-term fluctuations.

feed.title: Bristol Myers sues Amgen over proposed Opdivo biosimilar
feed.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb and Ono Pharmaceutical have filed a lawsuit against Amgen in Delaware federal court, aiming to block Amgen's proposed U.S. biosimilar of their cancer immunotherapy drug, Opdivo. The lawsuit alleges that Amgen's biosimilar infringes on several patents related to Opdivo, which generated over $5.9 billion in U.S. revenue for Bristol Myers last year. Bristol Myers expects to maintain patent exclusivity for Opdivo until 2028 and seeks to prevent sales of the biosimilar while their patents are in force.

feed.title: Jim Cramer on Arista (ANET) CEO: “She Is Money and the Company’s Fantastic”
feed.summary: Jim Cramer expressed strong confidence in Arista Networks (ANET) CEO Jayshree Ullal, praising her leadership and the company's performance, especially given its record-breaking $3 billion revenue quarter and increased full-year guidance. Despite challenges like customer concentration, gross margin pressures, and intense competition, Cramer and many hedge funds view ANET as a premier infrastructure asset, betting on its continued success in hyperscale AI deployments. The company's financial strength is highlighted by its significant revenue growth and substantial cash reserves.

feed.title: Teledyne Space Imaging Sensors Launch on ESA’s Sentinel-3C and FLEX Missions
feed.summary: Teledyne Space Imaging technology has successfully launched aboard two major European Space Agency (ESA) Earth observation missions: Sentinel-3C and the Fluorescence Explorer (FLEX). These missions, part of the EU Space Programme's Copernicus campaign, will provide critical observations of Earth's oceans, land surfaces, and vegetation. Teledyne's detectors will help map ocean color, vegetation cover, and land use, as well as measure the fluorescent signal from plants to understand photosynthesis and carbon cycles.

feed.title: AdaptHealth at Jefferies conference: focus shifts to scale and capitation
feed.summary: AdaptHealth discussed its business transformation at the Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference, shifting from an acquisition-led model to a focused approach on sleep health, respiratory care, and home medical equipment. The company highlighted new challenges such as a manufacturing price change and a difficult Kaiser Permanente contract rollout, alongside benefits from portfolio cleanup and national scale. AdaptHealth aims to become a preferred national provider by leveraging technology, strategic partnerships, and focusing on organic growth in its core segments, expecting mid-single-digit growth in sleep health.

feed.summary: Curbline Properties Corp. announced the acquisition of 62 convenience shopping centers for a total of $715.2 million from January through September 11, 2026. This includes 18 properties purchased for $198.6 million in the third quarter alone, funded by cash on hand and equity settlements. The company's CEO, David R. Lukes, noted a continued strong pipeline of opportunities.

feed.title: Enbridge Great Lakes Tunnel Project Faces Renewed Opposition in Michigan
feed.summary: Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer is renewing her opposition to Enbridge's Great Lakes Tunnel project, which aims to house replacement pipelines beneath the Straits of Mackinac. This renewed call comes after a recent pipeline accident in Wisconsin involving Enbridge's Line 5, leading Whitmer to urge the company to find an alternative that allows existing pipelines to be shut down sooner. Regulators in Michigan are also re-evaluating an environmental permit for the tunnel project following a Michigan Supreme Court decision that found the previous approval process too narrow.

feed.title: FedEx Freight expands exec's role after C-suite change
feed.summary: FedEx Freight has expanded the role of one of its executives following a recent C-suite change. This decision came after the company terminated another executive on September 2nd, leading to an immediate redistribution of responsibilities to include commercial operations for the remaining executive. The move suggests a strategic realignment within the company's leadership structure.
